main_text.p: ignea extinguentes, Sanctorum mereamur adjungi consortio.
main_text.head: DE S. HIERONYMO.
GRADVALE.
main_text.l: O robur Ecclesia, Mundi lux Hieronyme
main_text.head: VERSUS:
main_text.l: Tu lucerna viatorum Es Hieronyme beate,
In candelabro doctorum Speculum & decus rite,
Assis nobis alme pater Contra hostes, praesul vitae. Hallel.
main_text.head: VERSUS.
main_text.l: Ad te clamantes, mundo lux, sal terrae, guberna.
main_text.head: SEQUENTIA.
main_text.l: In profundo tenebrarum | Baptista cibis diris
Mundo fulsit fidus clarum | Socius in gloria. &c.
Magnus vir Hieronymus, | Deitas per egregia
Salvi sunt voventes, | Nos ducat ad caelestia.
Fama claret vivis, | Hieronyme nos corrige,
Apostolis summus viris | Et recto calle dirige.

page.notes: Sequentia is set in two columns; the lines are shown paired by row. The word at the lower right is a partly legible printed word ("Offer...") and is uncertain. The verse "Hallel." lines and the final line "berna" are read with some uncertainty.
